conbody.p: Navigation-based Smart Cruise Control is ready to operate if all the following conditions are satisfied:

li.p: Auto Highway Speed Change is enabled in the infotainment system settings
Driving on main roads of highways (or motorways)
A control zone (e.g., curve section) is detected ahead
he set speed of Smart Cruise Control is higher than the recommended safe speed

note.p: For more details on how to operate Smart Cruise Control, refer to SCC (Smart Cruise Control).
